messages:
maya: Deploy-bot kick: starting staged release window for release/2026-03-runtime-2.1. Change window 16:00-18:00 UTC. Need cross-service alignment: runtime, router, api, console. Pin plan? quick fallthrough if router header-shim fails.

sahil: thanks. do we have an explicit pin list for API/console/router? runtime has kernel change that can break header split.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] queueing staged rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Auto-hold checks: errors, p95 latency, schema diffs. Use /deploy abort to stop.

jess: proposal: sequence = runtime -> router -> api -> console. runtime needs to land first because it changes the KV header handling. Router must be updated next with shim to accept both header formats. API and console are backward compatible if router is in shim mode.

leo: agree with sequence. Can we add a timed fallthrough: if router shim doesn't stabilize within 15m at 25% canary, route traffic back to stable variant?

maya: yes. define rollback triggers now so oncall isn't guessing. my suggested thresholds: sustained error rate > 1% over 5m OR p95 latency increase > 30% over baseline for 10m OR any schema mismatch in error logs.

sahil: +1. add rollout hold on any 5xx spike in the canary pods. Also pin console feature flag to keep new UI disabled until final step.

jess: putting short preflight checklist here:
```
- confirm runtime binary v2.1 signed and pinned
- router shim image tagged router:shim-2026-03-p1 and pinned
- api image api:v1.9.2 (backwards compat) pinned
- console: staged-flag off for new KV inspector
- release notes posted + rollback playbook linked
```

leo: linked release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/2026-03-runtime-2.1 (internal). rollback playbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/release-rollback.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary started -> runtime @ 16:00 UTC (5%). Monitoring hooks: grafana-alerts, perf-trace, trace-sampler.

ops-bot: reminder: change window owner tag @oncall_jeff. Quiet window request approved. No DB migrations.

maya: runtime canary logs show a KV warning but no errors yet. router shim ready in staging. tagging router for canary step.

jess: router canary at 25% now. please watch header-split metrics (metric name: router.header_shim.fallback_rate).

leo: seeing fallback_rate spike to 0.08 at t+6m, trying to slow rollout to 10% and watch.

maya: good call. slowing to 10%, holding for 10m.

sahil: rolling back route->stable if fallback_rate > 0.05 sustained for 10m. that's our soft-fallthrough trigger.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] auto-hold triggered: router.fallback_rate breach at 8m. Rollback suggestion enqueued.

jess: ops, please confirm manual rollback decision window. if we hit the breachers above we should route back to stable router and keep runtime canary trimmed to 0.

leo: manual ack: initiating controlled rollback of router canary -> reverting traffic to stable router variant. runtime canary kept at 5% while we verify no lingering client mismatches.

maya: confirming rollback initiated. filing rollback incident note here: small header split inconsistency causing shim fallback. will add to release notes and patch the shim to check header ordering.

ops-bot: note: rollback completed at 16:12 UTC. telemetry shows errors back to baseline. recommend retest in staging with additional logging.

jess: action items post-rollback:
- add more robust header detection in shim (leo)
- increase integration test coverage for KV header permutations (sahil)
- re-run canary with slower step: 2% -> 8% -> 20% and longer holds (maya)

leo: assigned. will push shim patch to staging and request another dry run.

maya: thanks everyone. I will update release notes with the rollback blurb and proposed slower ramp. tagging @oncall_jeff to approve next try.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] thread note: next canary attempt will be blocked until all assigned action items are closed or explicitly waived. /deploy retry requires owners to confirm.

sahil: I will add the integration test for header permutations today. planning to re-run by EOD.

jess: closing the loop: once tests pass, we coordinate a new quiet window. leaving this thread open for status updates. :thumbsup:
